tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Search public hospital facts. Every condition must match the same campus and channel. Does not confirm clinical suitability or availability.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Read a published institution and its sourced campus/channel facts. Internal booking fields are not exposed.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Read practical travel and hospital guides with examples from the same public directory.

tools.name: how_to_inquire
tools.description: Describe the user's free plain-text inquiry option. This tool does not submit or send anything.

tools.name: ask_public_facts
tools.description: Read a sourced administrative answer from published hospital facts. Include only a public administrative question, not reports, passport numbers or personal medical details. This read-only tool does not create an inquiry, send email, book, upload or pay.

tools.name: prepare_inquiry_link
tools.description: Prepare a link to the free inquiry form, prefilled with a published institution (optionally its campus and service channel), city and an administrative topic. The link is for the user to open; the user writes the question, consents and verifies their email. This read-only tool does not submit an inq

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_public_facts, prepare_inquiry_link · Public sink: how_to_inquire, ask_public_facts, prepare_inquiry_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_public_facts, prepare_inquiry_link · Public sink: how_to_inquire, ask_public_facts, prepare_inquiry_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
